title: Impact Games India_Cohost Club RCAP
summary: Rotary Club of Addiction Prevention, 3141 was a co host for the Impact Games India hosted by Rotary Club of Mumbai SOBO.
description:
Rotary Club of Addiction Prevention, 3141 was a co host for the Impact Games India hosted by Rotary Club of Mumbai SOBO. Our club members, Rtn Dr Alefiya Kambathy participated in Scrabble, Rtn Hetal Sanghavi participated in Carrom and won all the rounds, Rtn Siddharth participated in Chess and with Rtn Dr Nilam in Bridge card Game.
Another thrilling Co-hosting event was the Mumbai's Coolest Football match on the 10th October. The match was won by our club sponsored team Gopi Birla School boys. Around 17 school teams participated with 500+ players. It was a fun filled sports event with one single aim " Say NO to Drugs" The Icecream helped in cooling the players during the heated matches. Every scoop raised funds for charity.
location: K J Somaiya College Ground, Maharashtra
